figures.heading: Active tab after deactivating everything it can
captions: What stays: COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold (always available) and Net 30 (the default, so it can't be deactivated). Every other term, the shop's own included, can be deactivated (S1-E1).
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).

texts.text: Active tab after deactivating everything it can
Cash on delivery. COD customers can't charge to account, so payment is taken when the invoice is created.
Paid when the invoice is created
Payment is due on the invoice date, but you can create the invoice without taking payment.
No invoices can be created for a customer on Credit Hold until their credit term is changed.
